subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should this Trim OS report be handled as a core Gateway protocol/client fix, a Trim OS package config-management fix, or held for logs before changing any auth behavior?
rationale: The plausible fixes touch Gateway pairing and shared-auth boundaries, while the config-regenerating Trim OS app manager is not present in this repository and the failing frame is still missing.

options.title: Collect protocol and package proof first
options.body: Ask for redacted `--ws-log full` or Gateway logs, the failing `connect` protocol range, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and before/after generated config before choosing a code or package fix.

options.title: Core diagnostics repair
options.body: If logs show a current OpenClaw client emits the wrong protocol or opaque diagnostics, fix the Gateway/CLI diagnostic or packaging path without loosening auth.

options.title: Route package config management
options.body: If the only reproducible defect is `trim.openclaw` regenerating `gateway.auth`, keep core auth strict and route the rewrite behavior to the package owner.

recommendation.title: Collect protocol and package proof first
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted `--ws-log full` or Gateway logs, the failing `connect` protocol range, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and before/after generated config before choosing a code or package fix.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history across gateway protocol compatibility, pairing approval, and user-facing gateway diagnostics.
